description: Over-representation of police-reported speeding in fatal crashes: CRSS-only ratio (fatal-crash share over all-crash share, both CRSS) next to the mixed FARS/CRSS ratio
population: CRSS police-reported crashes 2016-2024 with a determinable NHTSA-imputed maximum severity (MAXSEV_IM 0-4)
method: Weighted domain means; ratio of the CRSS fatal-crash share to the CRSS all-crash share with joint Taylor linearisation (25 strata / 67 PSUs, t 42 df); the mixed ratio divides the FARS census share by the CRSS all-crash share (CI: CRSS denominator only). The CRSS-only ratio is a lower bound on the over-representation under full recording only if CRSS records speeding in non-fatal crashes at least as fully as in fatal ones, which is untested (see fars_crss_recording)
